description: Kotlin object defining an in-memory, static quiz repository for a quiz platform. Includes sample quiz data with questions and choices, and provides methods to retrieve quizzes.

classes.name: Object InMemoryQuizRepository
classes.description: A singleton object acting as an in-memory repository for quizzes, providing access to sample quiz data without persistence.

methods.name: getQuizzes
methods.description: Returns the list of sample quizzes.

methods.name: getQuizById
methods.description: Retrieves a quiz matching the provided ID, or null if not found.
